sources.title: GitHub - VINHYU/OpenSpatial
sources.snippet: OpenSpatial is an open-source 3D spatial understanding data engine engineered for high quality, extensive scalability, broad task diversity, and optimized efficiency. By bridging the gap between massive 2D web data and complex 3D spatial reasoning, OpenSpatial provides a comprehensive suite for the next generation of Embodied AI and World Models.

sources.title: OpenSpatial: A Principled Data Engine for Empowering Spatial Intelligence
sources.snippet: By open-sourcing OpenSpatial, we aim to democratize the creation of high-quality data, serving as a robust cornerstone for the community to advance embodied AI and robotics.
